256-bit unsigned integer type with byte swap, compare, equality, and bit access helpers.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_uint256_t` type and basic operations for 256-bit unsigned integers. The file stores a 256-bit value as either `4` `ulong` limbs or `32` bytes, and it applies alignment rules so arrays and structs do not waste space. It also provides inline helpers for byte swapping, equality testing, comparison, and reading a single bit from the value. The header includes `fd_uint256_mul.h` to add multiplication support for the same integer type.
